subject_meta_title: 2-Year Fixed Mortgage Rates: Bank of England Averages
subject_meta_description: Average 2-year fixed mortgage rates from the Bank of England by deposit size, compared with 5-year fixes and Bank Rate.

label: Bank of England Bank Rate
context: Set by the Monetary Policy Committee, which meets eight times a year. Held at 3.75% on 17 September 2026.

label: Average 2-year fixed rate, 75% loan-to-value
context: Bank of England average of rates advertised by UK lenders in August 2026 (quoted household interest rates, Bankstats table G1.3), for borrowers with a 25% deposit.

label: Average 2-year fixed rate, 90% loan-to-value
context: Bank of England average of rates advertised by UK lenders in August 2026 (quoted household interest rates, Bankstats table G1.3), for borrowers with a 10% deposit.

label: Average 2-year fixed rate, 95% loan-to-value
context: Bank of England average of rates advertised by UK lenders in August 2026 (quoted household interest rates, Bankstats table G1.3), for borrowers with a 5% deposit.

label: Average 5-year fixed rate, 75% loan-to-value
context: Bank of England average of rates advertised by UK lenders in August 2026 (quoted household interest rates, Bankstats table G1.3). For comparison with the 2-year rate at the same deposit size.
